KPlugin.Description: Where am I? Live map of the BeaconFix position fix (Wi-Fi beacons via BeaconDB, Starlink GPS, or IP), nearby places from OpenStreetMap, the beacons around you with their Wi-Fi names and live events (new, lost, louder, placed) animated on the map, and your trip: distances, time moving, speed, elevation, sun, places visited and milestones.
KPlugin.Name: BeaconFix
